biography.plain_text: John Rost is an American entrepreneur who founded Fiesta Auto Insurance, developing a chain of insurance and tax-preparation franchises serving Hispanic communities. He had previously owned and sold an insurance franchise in Arizona. Fiesta grew from four company-owned agencies into a national network before private-equity investment backed its next expansion.

long_biography.plain_text:
At Fiesta, John Rost made time for conversations with franchise owners and frontline employees about problems they encountered in their work. When clerical staff raised accounting difficulties, those discussions led to changes in the company's software. He encouraged managers to ask about possible solutions as well as successes, drawing on employees' experience of daily operations.

Rost also took part in a 2020 expedition to Challenger Deep in the Mariana Trench. He descended after Kathryn Sullivan and Vanessa O'Brien, joining the small group of people who had reached the ocean's deepest point. The expedition collected samples, measured water temperature and recorded marine life.
